items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: When you used to go up to Richard Taylor and play with Rene, you told me you bought a keg of beer at that time.

ctx.x: No, I didn't make them, but I had a chance to make them, but I wouldn't have gone with them. The reason why I did make them, making records ain't easy enough. Oh, that ain't easy, yeah. I mean, everything's got to be right down the top. In that studio, you'd be shut up in that room so hot. And you don't talk, you won't wait by sign. Everything is signed with. Because they're basically something that comes out on the record. And then sometimes they'll make one number. You've got three or four records, four or five…
Well, something I forgot to ask you too, another thing. When you used to go up to Richard Taylor and play with Rene, you told me you bought a keg of beer at that time.
Oh, we used to buy it.

items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: Yeah, Richard Taylor. Well, we all came up together.

ctx.x: To rehearsal at the Taylor Boys house. You said you went there? Oh yeah. Richard Taylor?
Yeah, Richard Taylor. Well, we all came up together.
Oh, and you were just a kid?
